name: Kanou Masayuki
source:
High school third grader, a student at Yahiro Gakuen who is one year older than the protagonist. Masayuki's family owns a shrine. He is honest, quiet and short-spoken.
Due to his calm and stable personality, he is highly trusted by the teacher. He also has a fierce feeling that he is willing to go into battle. If he wants to protect someone dear to him, he is willing to throw away the ways of a quiet honor student.
